Intro, build up, drop, breakdown, outro.

Indian melodic framework of notes, patterns and mood.

short.model: Dramatic accented marcado rhythm and the bandoneón-led orquesta típica; habanera rhythm, portamento and pizzicato are also typical.

short.q: Explain how the structure of salsa uses call and response.
short.model: A lead singer (sonero) sings a phrase and the chorus (coro) answers; instruments such as brass can also respond.
A slow, free introduction to the rāga played over the drone without tabla, exploring the notes of the rāga.

short.q: Describe two features of EDM production.
short.model: Use of synthesisers, drum machine, samples and loops; build up leading to a drop with effects such as reverb and delay.

short.q: Give two features of Arab takht music.
short.model: Maqām with quarter tones; instruments such as oud, qanun and nay; rhythmic cycles (īqā'āt); heterophonic decorated melody.
